name: 手绘活页纸笔草图风
origin: 致敬 looseleaf 与 Excalidraw 手绘笔记本美学——横格活页纸、红色竖向装订线、不规则钢笔手绘线框、荧光笔涂抹与和纸胶带贴纸。
originEn: Inspired by looseleaf and Excalidraw notebook aesthetics — ruled loose-leaf paper, red margin lines, organic hand-drawn ink borders, highlighter strokes, and washi tape.
bestFor: 白板协作工具、个人数字花园、知识笔记应用、轻松亲和的独立产品落地页。
bestForEn: Whiteboard tools, digital gardens, note-taking apps, approachable indie product landing pages.
donts: 严禁使用死板对称的 8px/12px 标准圆角——必须使用非对称椭圆圆角或 SVG turbulence 模拟手绘抖动线条
严禁使用柔和模糊投影（blur > 4px），阴影应为干脆的 2px~3px 钢笔复描硬边阴影
严禁使用冰冷的深色科技渐变遮盖活页横格纸底纹
dontsEn: NEVER use uniform symmetric border-radius (e.g. rounded-xl) — use asymmetric organic radii or SVG displacement for hand-drawn wobble
NEVER use soft Gaussian drop shadows — use crisp 2px–3px ink offset strokes
NEVER cover the ruled notebook substrate with glossy gradients
prompt:
请采用「手绘活页纸笔草图风（Looseleaf Paper & Ink Sketch）」构建此界面：
1. 纸面基底：暖白活页纸 #FDFCF7 叠加 28px 间距浅蓝横格线与左侧 40px 处竖向红装订线（rgba(225,92,92,0.42)）。
2. 手绘线框与按钮：所有卡片与按钮采用 2px solid #24292F 钢笔描边，配合非对称手绘圆角（border-radius: 255px 15px 225px 15px / 15px 225px 15px 255px）与 2px 3px 0 硬边复描阴影。
3. 视觉挂件：重点词汇用 #FEF08A 倾斜荧光笔高亮涂抹，卡片顶部可点缀半透明胶带或回形针标签。
promptEn:
Build this interface using the "Looseleaf Paper & Ink Sketch" aesthetic:
1. Ruled Notebook Paper: Warm #FDFCF7 paper with 28px horizontal blue ruling lines and a vertical red margin line at 40px.
2. Hand-Drawn Ink Borders: Frame cards and buttons with 2px solid #24292F strokes, asymmetric sketchy border-radius (255px 15px 225px 15px / 15px 225px 15px 255px), and crisp 2px 3px 0 ink offset shadows.
3. Annotations: Highlight key phrases with #FEF08A marker strokes and top masking-tape strips.

primitive.summary: 带活页纸横格装订线、非对称手绘抖动边框、顶部胶带贴与荧光笔涂抹的手绘容器原件
primitive.summaryEn: Ruled loose-leaf notebook card with wobbly hand-drawn ink borders, masking tape strip, and marker highlight
